description: This file defines the Configuration class in the Aws\DefaultsMode namespace, responsible for managing and retrieving AWS SDK default mode configurations, including loading configuration data from a JSON file and providing accessor methods.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Defines configuration settings for AWS SDK default modes, including constructor logic for loading and applying mode-specific settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Configuration object with a specified mode, loading additional settings from a JSON file if the mode is not 'legacy'.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the current mode of configuration.

methods.name: getStsRegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns settings related to STS regional endpoints.

methods.name: getS3UsEast1RegionalEndpoints
methods.description: Returns S3 US East 1 regional endpoint configuration.

methods.name: getConnectTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the connection timeout setting in milliseconds.

methods.name: getHttpRequestTimeoutInMillis
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the current configuration settings as an associative array.
